subject: Save stanfit object to mongo database

messages.author: 77e72e34bf8c033f
messages.subject: Save stanfit object to mongo database
parts:
Hi all

I am trying to save a stanfit object to a mongo database, using rmongodb for R. I'm no expert in mongo, but this is what I have tried:

buf <- mongo.bson.buffer.create()
mongo.bson.buffer.append(buf, 'stanfit', serialize(stanfit, NULL, FALSE))
mongo.insert(mongo, 'my.database', mongo.bson.from.buffer(buf))

which mongo refuses. If I wrap stanfit in as.matrix it works just fine...

Might this related to the environment stuff discussed in this post?

https://groups.google.com/forum/#!msg/stan-users/mp4wF42zjws/HL7W_AWF_xIJ

Any help would be greatly appreciated.

Best,
Per

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Save stanfit object to mongo database [RStan issue?]
parts:
I'd assume the rmongodb function just needs an argument of
the right type, such as a matrix.

Is wrapping in as.matrix() causing problems for some other
reason?

If so, you're going to need help from someone on the Stan team
who knows more about the R interface.

- Bob

messages.author: 77e72e34bf8c033f
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Save stanfit object to mongo database [RStan issue?]
parts:
I made some progress in resolving my issue. 

I think the real issue is mongodbs size limit for inserts (the error issued by the mongo was a pretty uninformative FALSE.... :). And the reason why as.matrix(stanfit) worked, was because it drastically reduced the size of the serialized stanfit object, and happened to accidentally make it smaller than the mongodb insert size limit.

Thank you for your answers,
Per
